text:
Sam: FYI — Aurora reported intermittent 99th pct token latency spikes after last week's kernel selector tweak. Root message here so we can collate notes.
Jana: Thanks. I see a correlated KV cache eviction increase for org_id=aurora around the same time. Looks like partition 42 had a burst of cold prefixes.
Sasha: I ran flamegraphs on the traces — the token-level breakdown shows a big jump in `kv_read_time` for long sequences. Not CPU-bound, mostly wait on cache misses + remote fallback. :thinking_face:
Omar: Do we have the per-route KPIs for Aurora? wondering if a particular model/route triggered long sequences.
Sam: Route `/chat/standard` is the hot one for them. They do a lot of multi-turn code completions with long context.
Jana: I created a temporary grafana panel for org-scoped token latency. Query (Prometheus) I used:

```
histogram_quantile(0.99,
  sum(rate(token_latency_seconds_bucket{org_id="aurora",route="/chat/standard"}[5m]))
  by (le)
)
```

Shows the 99th token latency trend.
Sasha: Also instrumented a KV-specific histogram:

```
sum(rate(kv_read_duration_seconds_bucket{org_id="aurora"}[5m])) by (le,kv_op)
```

Compare `kv_op="local_lookup"` vs `kv_op="remote_fetch"` — remote spikes line up with the tail.
Infra-bot: Deploy note: kernel-selector v2.3.1 rolled 2026-03-10 03:12UTC to default pool; can be rolled back per pool.
Mira: From product side, Aurora is on Dedicated but multi-workspace. They want per-workspace dashboards and limited RBAC so their SREs only see their org data.
Sam: Action items proposed:
  - Add org-scoped panels for token histograms and kv_read_breakdown (Jana)
  - Add RBAC gating on Grafana folder for `org_id` view and map to customer SSO groups (Product + EngPlatform)
  - Reduce metric cardinality by sampling workspace-level debug traces but keep full for flagged orgs (Sasha + Omar)
  - Add fallback metrics to detect cache-eviction-to-remote ratio > 5% (alert)

Jana: For sampling config draft:

```
# sampling rules (pseudo-yaml)
sampling:
  default_workspace_sample_pct: 1    # 1% of workspaces full traces
  high_vet_orgs:
    - org_id: "aurora"
      sample_pct: 100
    - org_id: "beta-corp"
      sample_pct: 25
```

That keeps cardinality bounded while allowing deep dives for problematic tenants.
Sasha: To implement RBAC in dashboards we should ensure every panel query uses `org_id` label and Grafana provisioning attaches the org_id filter for the customer's role. Example panel query param: `org_id=$customer_org`.
Omar: One tricky bit: KV metrics currently include `kv_key` label for debugging; that kills cardinality. We should replace `kv_key` with `kv_key_prefix` (N=4 chars) and only emit full key at debug level via sampled traces.
Sam: Good call. That aligns with our quantization/metrics policy.
Mira: Customer comms note: tell Aurora we're investigating and we've put them on high-sample tracing; we'll share an org-scoped dashboard link once RBAC is ready. Keep wording non-technical.
Jana: I'll prototype the dashboard folder structure today: `/customers/<org_id>/observability` with read access mapped to SSO group `aurora-sre`.
Sasha: I'll open a PR to add the eviction ratio alert:

```
expr: (sum(rate(kv_remote_fetchs_total{org_id="$org_id"}[5m]))
       /
       sum(rate(kv_reads_total{org_id="$org_id"}[5m]))) > 0.05
for: 5m
```

Trigger priority P2 and route to oncall plus customer SRE when it's a dedicated tenant.
Sam: Assignments: Jana -> dashboard + Grafana RBAC prototype. Sasha -> sampling + alert PR. Omar -> kv metric label change + testing. I'll coordinate rollback plan for kernel-selector if we see more regression.
Mira: I'll draft the customer-facing message and loop in CSM.
Infra-bot: Notebook snapshot created: /infra/notebooks/aurora-kv-investigation-1893456000.ipynb
Sam: Thanks all. Let's sync in 30m in #eng-runtime if we need a quick decision on rollback. :thumbsup:
